communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: LBPD Officer Outside Employment Records/Data
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following documents that are possessed by the Long Beach Police Department:

-All Collateral Employment/Business Activity Authorization Request forms filed by LBPD officers in the last 3 years. 

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

I currently have requests pending with your agency that are more than 5 YEARS old without a response, despite the laws 10 DAY timeframe. As this is a very simple request and something the department should be keeping track of anyway, I don't see why it should take more than 10 days.  

If you can not respond to this request in 10 days, I ask that you at least follow the law and detail why you are unable to comply. 

If you feel redactions are needed for some reason, I am happy to discuss and have no issue with officer's personal information being redacted.  The information I am interested is the names of the potential outside employeers.  

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. Please reach out with any issues you have with this request when they arise.  

Sincerely,

Greg Buhl
